description:
What if Unity Hub and GitHub Desktop had a Baby but its Adopted? Yeah..


What's new in v1.5.3 - Another Small Hotfix that i forgot to push with v1.5.2 lol
🚀 New
- New Show Session Timer option in Customize View: hide the live timer that counts up next to the Open button while a project is running, separately from Show Time Tracked (#215)
🐛 Fixes
- Fixed the Versions page showing an outdated list of Godot releases (for example stopping at an older beta): newly published releases now appear as soon as GodotHub fetches them, and the list refreshes when you come back to the window instead of only on the next launch
